description: Kenmerkende en gave dijken van bovenregionale betekenis is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze kaart toont de 'Kenmerkende en gave dijken van bovenregionale betekenis' zoals vermeld in Lijst 3a in de publicatie 'Ontgonnen Verleden' (Baas e.a., Landview/LNV, 2001). De 76 dijken/dijksystemen zijn in 2023 in kaart gebracht op basis van recente brondata, te weten: waterkeringen gezamenlijke waterschappen, Top10NL (wegdeel hartlijn; reliëf talud hoge zijde), RWS-dijkringen en de RCE-dijklijnenkaart. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
